overall_notes: This paper focuses on prosodic evaluation of speech-to-speech models, specifically emphasis transfer. The main contributions are the EmphAssess benchmark, EmphaClass emphasis classifier, and evaluation pipeline. The paper evaluates both speech resynthesis and speech-to-speech translation tasks. Human evaluation was conducted with expert annotators for both English and Spanish. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and consolidation.
